 In twelve months, Alice Tubello has gone from No. 425 to No. 146 in the world rankings, while winning three clay-court titles in 2026, including the WTA 125 in Curitiba.
 Tatjana Maria's two titles in 2026 were won on hard court and grass; yet she enters this clay-court tournament as the No. 1 seed.
 Their latest defeats share a precise coincidence: Tatjana Maria and Alice Tubello both lost to Bianca Andreescu, five days apart.
 Alice Tubello has already won in Sopo in 2024, but in a W35 event; this time she returns there in a WTA 125 tournament.
 Was this useful? Yes No Match preview
 This second round of the WTA 125 in Sopó pits No. 1 seed Tatjana Maria, ranked 68th in the world, against Alice Tubello, ranked 146th. Maria comes in with 7 wins in her last 10 matches, while Tubello has 9 in her last 10. The stakes also involve the rankings, as Maria is currently No. 68 after being No. 41 twelve months ago.
The clay-court context favors Maria's experience, as she has 52 wins and 79 losses on the main circuit, but Tubello won the WTA 125 in Curitiba this season. This will be their first meeting. Maria has two days of rest versus one for Tubello, and the matchup between the German's one-handed backhand and the Frenchwoman's two-handed backhand will be one to watch. Was this useful?
